title: SHA-256 miner (what the Antminer was built for)
summary: SHA-256 in hardware, three units side by side: hash any message, then mine like Bitcoin (double SHA-256 over a block header, searching the nonce) and race the ARM. Finds the real nonce of Bitcoin block 125552.
parts: nothing: everything happens inside the FPGA
tested: 8/8 on the board 2026-10-05, 1 127 820 double hashes per second, 127.5 MHz
